risks.risk: Missing parts or incomplete assembly (linkages, sensors, solenoids, torque converter, cooler lines, mounts).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the transmission/gearbox ID tag or casting/part number (the one that determines exact model/fitment).
Send the vehicle details it came from: VIN (or at least engine code) and whether it’s 4x2/4x4, plus the exact transmission type (if known).
Send a short video showing the gearbox test/engagement (or at minimum proof of operation) and fluid condition.
Confirm what is included: torque converter (if applicable), sensors/solenoids, cooler lines, shifter linkage, and any adapters/mounts—photos of each.
